comparison.objective: Pack three cases into two bays while ensuring nothing rests on the fragile blue case.
comparison.physical_skill: Plan packing order and form a valid two-object stack in tight locker bays.
comparison.success_condition: All cases flat, lengthwise, stable, at most two per stack, with no grey case on the blue one.
comparison.reason: Tests load-path-aware packing and stacking, unrelated to fracture mechanics or fragment handling.
